one_line_reason: Shortlist has no isolated-yohimbe efficacy trial; the two dosed studies are higenamine+caffeine+yohimbe combination products and the third is a broad multi-supplement review with no yohimbe-specific effect size.
blockers: The two intervention studies dose yohimbe only as part of a 3-ingredient stack (higenamine + caffeine + yohimbe bark extract), so no single-ingredient yohimbe effect can be isolated.
The systematic review discusses yohimbe as one of 11 pooled supplements without reporting a yohimbe-specific effect size or conclusion.

handoff_pmids.note: Acute RCT of a higenamine + caffeine (270 mg) + yohimbe bark extract combination; raised free fatty acids, energy expenditure, heart rate (~3 bpm), and systolic blood pressure (~12 mmHg); authors attribute the hemodynamic changes mainly to caffeine/yohimbine, not higenamine.

8-week RCT titled a clinical safety assessment comparing placebo, higenamine, caffeine, and higenamine+caffeine+yohimbe bark extract; reported no statistically significant changes in vital signs or labs for any group.

excluded_pmids.reason: Systematic review of 11 pooled weight-loss dietary supplements (chitosan, chromium picolinate, ephedra, yohimbe, etc.); abstract gives only an overall negative conclusion and does not report yohimbe-specific results.
